name: str0m
stack: str0m (Rust, sans-I/O): its own ICE agent (is), DTLS (dimpl), SCTP (sctp-proto), SRTP and RTP
version: str0m 0.26.0 with the rust-crypto backend (str0m-rust-crypto 0.7.0, dimpl 0.9.0, str0m-proto 0.8.0, is 0.12.1, sctp-proto 0.10.9; peers/str0m/Cargo.lock)

turnUdp.reason: str0m has no TURN client: address discovery, STUN and TURN are left to the application
turnUdp.cite: str0m 0.26.0 docs/ice.md, "Address discovery, STUN and TURN out of scope"

turnTcp.reason: str0m has no TURN client: address discovery, STUN and TURN are left to the application
turnTcp.cite: str0m 0.26.0 docs/ice.md, "Address discovery, STUN and TURN out of scope"

turnTls.reason: str0m has no TURN client: address discovery, STUN and TURN are left to the application
turnTls.cite: str0m 0.26.0 docs/ice.md, "Address discovery, STUN and TURN out of scope"

mdns.reason: str0m neither registers nor resolves mDNS (.local) candidate names: candidates are addresses the application gives it
mdns.cite: str0m 0.26.0 docs/ice.md (address discovery is the application's) and is 0.12.1 src/candidate.rs (a candidate is a SocketAddr)

unbundled.reason: str0m runs one ICE transport per session: every m-line must be bundled
unbundled.cite: str0m 0.26.0 docs/SDP.md, "BUNDLE and Bundle Policies": "str0m only supports a single ICE transport, meaning all m-lines must be bundled together"
